newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 7.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on January 7. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Indonesian police have arrested 72 students for allegedly hijacking an express bus in Jakarta and attacking some of the 25 passengers on board. Police confiscated at least five daggers and a number of knives from the students.

President Suharto proposed increasing the state budget by 11.6 percent for the 1997/1998 fiscal year during an annual parliamentary session. The draft budget, which when adjusted for inflation increased by only five percent, is planned to balance at 101.08 trillion rupiah.
Speaker of the House of Representatives Wahono said the widening economic and political disparities in Indonesian society may well trigger more mass violence.

Armed Forces Commander General Feisal Tanjung said last week's ethnic riots in Sanggau Ledo in West Kalimantan had ended and the situation in the area was under control. Five people died, nine were injured and dozens of houses were burned in the disturbance sparked by a row over a woman.

An Indonesian colonel has been arrested by the Dutch police for alledgedly trying to smuggle out about 20,600 ecstasy pills from the Netherlands. Quoting the Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf, the report said the colonel, whose unit or service was not revealed, was caught at a Dutch airport.
